subject.title: fix(qa): Mantis before-after exits when a lane command stalls

question: Should Mantis before/after enforce the new fixed 2–30 minute per-stage deadlines in addition to the inactivity watchdog, or should it retain inactivity-only termination for active commands?
rationale: The change is operationally meaningful for live QA evidence runs: fixed deadlines can stop a command that is still producing output, and the correct limit is an owner policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept staged deadlines
options.body: Keep the proposed worktree, install, build, QA, and cleanup deadlines, with focused proof that active commands within expected live-run bounds are not interrupted.

options.title: Use inactivity-only termination
options.body: Remove fixed stage caps for commands that continue producing output and retain only the watchdog and process-tree cleanup behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept staged deadlines
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed worktree, install, build, QA, and cleanup deadlines, with focused proof that active commands within expected live-run bounds are not interrupted.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author can clarify the intended timeout model and supply any requested proof; a QA Lab owner should make the final policy decision.
